video_title: We CRASH OUT on why Jaylen Brown is a BETTER SG than Anthony Edwards 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Jaylen Brown is a better shooting guard than Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is clear-cut number one. He's done more and he has done more than Anthony Edwards.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is clear-cut number one. He's done more and he has done more than Anthony Edwards. He's been an Eastern Conference MVP, a Finals MVP. He's been higher in the MVP voting and he's averaged more than Anthony Edwards.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton argues Anthony Edwards is a better shooting guard than Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown has been closer to being an MVP in the league than Anthony Edwards has.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown has been closer to being an MVP in the league than Anthony Edwards has, as he's been in the league. I can't help he's in the West. What does that have to do with being an MVP? When he came in the league, he's been a clear-cut number one since he stepped in this league.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Anthony Edwards is a better facilitator than Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I think Anthony Edwards can handle the ball better.
quotes.quote: I can give you the same answer that I can say about Jaylen Brown. I can give you the same answer. They both can shoot. I think Anthony Edwards can handle the ball better. But they both can shoot, they both are extremely athletic, they both defend.

quotes.quote: Donovan Mitchell has statistically and awards wise and totality has done more than Anthony Edwards. The only thing Jaylen Brown has over him, and that's probably why he's over him, is the championships and stuff. But he's had more first teams. I think he's had more All-NBA teams. Why do we not think about Donovan the way we think about Jaylen Brown and Anthony Edwards?
